newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Hanbo files for receivership.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Hanbo files for receivership.

text.p: Hanbo Steel Co, South Korea's second-biggest steelmaker, filed for court receivership on Tuesday, company officials said.
Hanbo Steel, flagship of the Hanbo Group, defaulted on debt repayments last week.

The officials said Hanbo Steel's unlisted affilate Hanbo Corp also filed for court receivership. Two other affiliates -- Sang-A Pharmaceutical Co Ltd and Hanbo Energy Co -- were due to seek court protection later on Tuesday.

A group of 61 South Korean banks and financial institutions with loans to Hanbo Steel said on Monday it would support court receivership to keep the steelmaker afloat by suspending demands for debt repayment and resuming overdraft facilities.
The finance ministry said the steelmaker's loans from the financial institutions amounted to 4.95 trillion won, against its net worth of 224.3 billion won.
